features: Brushless motor delivers up to 5,000 staples per charge using an 18V LXT 5.0Ah battery
Drives standard 18 gauge 1/4 inch narrow crown staples from 3/8 inch to 1-1/2 inch
Spring-loaded driving mechanism provides increased power and consistent flush driving
Contact actuation and sequential actuation modes via select switch
Tool-less depth adjustment for precise flush and countersink nailing
Ergonomic soft rubber grip design for increased comfort on the job
